WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i` dereferences the first row without checking it exists; the fallback to uncategorized_category_id only runs `if category_id == 0`, which never executes if `[0]` is nil. adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration does `execute(...)[0]['id'].to_i` for the `embed_category` lookup. If the query returns no rows (e.g., the `site_settings` table has no `embed_category` row), `execute(...)[0]` is nil and `['id']` raises `NoMethodError`. The same pattern is used when falling back to `uncategorized_category_id` (`...[0]['value']`). This is a verifiable crash path based on the diff.
